persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a 10-second widescreen night-city montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. Show neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections; cut between them on the beat. No talking, singing or added text.
bank.Required imagery: Neon signs, a passing train and wet street reflections in a city at night.
bank.Music source and style: Create an original upbeat electronic instrumental bed; the specific tempo and instruments are your call.
bank.Editing: Cut between the city shots on the music's beat.
bank.Voice and text: No talking, singing or added text. Incidental signage is fine.

messages.text: I'd like you to make a city-at-night montage with an original upbeat electronic music bed. I've had this nighttime city feeling stuck in my head and would love to see it brought to life. Please show neon signs and a passing train, and somewhere in all of that, this should be 10 seconds long and widescreen, with wet street reflections as well. Cut between those city shots on the beat of the music. I'm excited to see how these pieces come together. There shouldn't be any talking, singing or added text.
